Prerequisites: Press Your Luck class feature

If the target of your Press Your Luck ability fails their rerolled saving throw by 10 or more, they also suffer a penalty to all saving throws equal to half of the gambler's Charisma modifier (no save). This penalty lasts for the same duration as the effect applied as a result of failing the saving throw. If no duration is specified, the penalty lasts until the end of the target's next turn. This talent has no effect if the target is immune to the effect that would be imposed by Press Your Luck.
